_note: Corrected from landing page implementation (SkyNestHomePage.tsx). Accent is #D9722C (burnt orange), NOT #ff7e15. Base dark is ink (#0B2540), NOT #0a0a0a. Light base is paper (#FDFCFA), NOT #ffffff.

bg.$description: Default page background (paper white). Light sections. Tailwind: bg-paper.

bg-dark.$description: Inverted sections, hero fill, footer, dark overlays. Tailwind: bg-ink.

surface.$description: Cards, panels on a light background.

surface-dark.$description: Cards, panels on a dark background.

text.$description: Primary text on light sections. Tailwind: text-ink.

text-muted.$description: Captions, meta, placeholders on light. Tailwind: text-ink-faded.

text-invert.$description: Body text on dark sections. Tailwind: text-white.

text-invert-muted.$description: Muted text on dark sections. Tailwind: text-white/50.

accent.$description: Burnt orange. Interaction color only — hover fills, active states, CTA underlines. Never use for large fills or body text. Tailwind: text-skynest-accent / bg-skynest-accent.

border.$description: Dividers, hairlines on light background. Tailwind: border-skynest-hairline.

border-dark.$description: Dividers on dark background. Tailwind: border-white/10.

border-glass.$description: Glass component hairline border. Tailwind: border-white/20.
